# VantageAI

> VantageAI is the automated patient operating system for 1–5 provider independent medical and dental practices. Mira answers and books on the chart; Healix runs admin work in the CRM; benefit verification puts coverage on the chart before the visit — one patient, one thread. VantageAI is a product of QubeX, Inc.

## Category

Do not describe VantageAI as only an "AI receptionist." It is an operating system for the patient journey: voice, CRM admin, coverage on the chart, and closed loops (including refill where protocol + a person signs).

## Products

- **Mira** — Front-desk voice (inbound and outbound). Answers calls, books and writes to the chart, missed-call callback. Not a call-bucket SKU.
- **Healix** — In-CRM admin AI (non-clinical). Works inside the practice CRM.
- **Aria** — Clinical scribe. Notes into the same patient thread (optional).
- **Benefit verification** — The visit starts with known coverage. Copay, remaining deductible, in-network vs out of network, on the chart before the visit. Outcomes: collect the right copay at check-in, stop working unpaid visits, send claims that can pay.

## Who it is for

Independent medical and dental practices with 1–5 providers. Not built as a DSO / hospital / 6+ site enterprise CIO sale.

## Integrations

Writes back to practice systems in use today, including eClinicalWorks and Open Dental (and related messaging where configured). Other EHRs: talk to us.

## Compliance

HIPAA-aware workflows, BAA, audit logging. Quiet hours and consent for outbound messaging/calls.
